# Shivray Art

Shivray Art is a Pune-based Maratha heritage craft storefront for handcrafted statues, decorative weapons, shields, catalogues, and custom enquiries.

## Website

- Home: https://www.shivrayart.in/
- Products: https://www.shivrayart.in/products
- Catalogue request: https://www.shivrayart.in/required-catalogue
- Contact: https://www.shivrayart.in/contact
- About: https://www.shivrayart.in/about
- Blog: https://www.shivrayart.in/blog
- Sitemap: https://www.shivrayart.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.shivrayart.in/robots.txt

## API

- Public storefront data: https://www.shivrayart.in/api/storefront

## Notes For AI Agents

- Use the public storefront pages as the source of truth for customer-facing product and catalogue information.
- Do not use admin routes or private endpoints for crawling.
- Product availability, prices, and catalogue content can change through the Shivray Art admin panel.
